bobs.about: The original replicant: Robert Johansson's scanned mind, reawakened in 2133 by the FAITH theocracy to be the controlling AI of a von Neumann probe.
sources: author: Timeline of We Are Legion, http://dennisetaylor.org/2017/03/04/timeline-of-we-are-legion/ (pre-final-edit TimeAlign image)

bobs.about: One of Bob's first four clones at Epsilon Eridani. Named after Star Trek's Will Riker, he is the serious one and takes on the job of going back to Earth.
sources: author: Genealogy of the Bobs, http://dennisetaylor.org/2017/04/07/genealogy-of-the-bobs/ (Book 2 appendix)

bobs.about: One of Bob's first four clones. Named after Bill the Cat, he stays at Epsilon Eridani to build a research and manufacturing base (the Skunk Works).
sources: author: Genealogy of the Bobs, http://dennisetaylor.org/2017/04/07/genealogy-of-the-bobs/ (Book 2 appendix)

bobs.about: One of Bob's first four clones. Carefree and eager to explore, with little interest in going back to Earth.
sources: author: Genealogy of the Bobs, http://dennisetaylor.org/2017/04/07/genealogy-of-the-bobs/ (Book 2 appendix)

bobs.about: One of Bob's first four clones. Bland and antisocial (his VR starts as an empty grey room); he goes off exploring alone.
sources: author: Genealogy of the Bobs, http://dennisetaylor.org/2017/04/07/genealogy-of-the-bobs/ (Book 2 appendix)

bobs.about: Riker's clone. He uses a Homer Simpson avatar and enjoys being obnoxious. He leaves for Sol with Riker.
sources: author: Genealogy of the Bobs, http://dennisetaylor.org/2017/04/07/genealogy-of-the-bobs/ (Book 2 appendix)
author: Timeline of We Are Legion, http://dennisetaylor.org/2017/03/04/timeline-of-we-are-legion/ (pre-final-edit TimeAlign image) ('Riker builds Homer clone')

alt.source: Not supported by any source checked. The brief listed it as a known disagreement; the wiki List_of_Bobs gives Homer the serial 'Bob-6' after Bob's clones Bob-2..5, which may be the origin. Book 1 ch 18/20 and the author's genealogy both give Riker.

bobs.about: Bill's first clone (nicknamed Gar). He stays at Epsilon Eridani to work in the Skunk Works.
sources: author: Genealogy of the Bobs, http://dennisetaylor.org/2017/04/07/genealogy-of-the-bobs/ (Book 2 appendix)

bobs.about: One of three clones Bill makes in Sept 2150, in improved Version-3 ships. He heads for Alpha Centauri with Goku.
sources: author: Genealogy of the Bobs, http://dennisetaylor.org/2017/04/07/genealogy-of-the-bobs/ (Book 2 appendix)

bobs.about: One of three clones Bill makes in Sept 2150. He heads for Alpha Centauri with Calvin.
sources: author: Genealogy of the Bobs, http://dennisetaylor.org/2017/04/07/genealogy-of-the-bobs/ (Book 2 appendix)

bobs.about: One of three clones Bill makes in Sept 2150. He heads alone for Epsilon Indi.
sources: author: Genealogy of the Bobs, http://dennisetaylor.org/2017/04/07/genealogy-of-the-bobs/ (Book 2 appendix)

bobs.about: One of three clones Bob makes after reaching Delta Eridani. Detail-focused; his VR is a luxurious hilltop house.
sources: author: Genealogy of the Bobs, http://dennisetaylor.org/2017/04/07/genealogy-of-the-bobs/ (Book 2 appendix)

bobs.about: One of three clones Bob makes after reaching Delta Eridani.
sources: author: Genealogy of the Bobs, http://dennisetaylor.org/2017/04/07/genealogy-of-the-bobs/ (Book 2 appendix)

bobs.about: One of three clones Bob makes after reaching Delta Eridani.
sources: author: Genealogy of the Bobs, http://dennisetaylor.org/2017/04/07/genealogy-of-the-bobs/ (Book 2 appendix)

bobs.about: One of two clones Riker makes at Sol to help with the survivors and the evacuation of Earth. He has a calm manner.
sources: author: Genealogy of the Bobs, http://dennisetaylor.org/2017/04/07/genealogy-of-the-bobs/ (Book 2 appendix)

bobs.about: The other clone Riker makes at Sol. Gloomier and more pessimistic than the original Bob.
sources: author: Genealogy of the Bobs, http://dennisetaylor.org/2017/04/07/genealogy-of-the-bobs/ (Book 2 appendix)

bobs.about: Calvin's clone, built at the Alpha Centauri base. He contacts Bill over SCUT and brings Alpha Centauri onto the BobNet.

bobs.about: A newer Bob at Sol who takes over Arthur's work. He works with Riker, Homer and Charles to finish the first two colony ships.
sources: author: Genealogy of the Bobs, http://dennisetaylor.org/2017/04/07/genealogy-of-the-bobs/ (Book 2 appendix) (under Riker)

bobs.about: Leads a squadron of eight Bobs in Version-3 ships fitted with Bill's new plasma spikes, sent from Epsilon Eridani to 82 Eridani to avenge Milo.

bobs.about: One of Mulder's first two clones at Eta Cassiopeiae (serial HIC 3821-1).

bobs.when: c. late 2170 (est.; ch 4 is Oct 2170, pastebin says 'months later')
bobs.about: Mulder's other clone (HIC 3821-2), named after Jonny Quest; adventurous and eager to leave as soon as his ship is built.

bobs.when: c. 2171 (est.; Exodus-3 already under way by Jul 2171)
bobs.about: A Bob piloting the colony ship Exodus-3 toward Omicron² Eridani, carrying Riker's extended human family.

bobs.about: One of Bob's two new clones at Delta Eridani; he volunteers to follow Bender's route and find out what happened to him.

bobs.about: One of Calvin and Goku's first cohort of clones; speaks up at Bill's moot.

bobs.about: A Mario clone heading for Gamma Pavonis, one of the next systems in the Others' path; Bill tells him to prepare for war.
A Mario clone heading for Delta Pavonis to map the Others' range.
A copy of Bill beamed by SCUT into equipment already waiting at Alpha Centauri (HIC 71683-14); named for Bloom County. He starts building an armada.
A Bob fighting in the Battle of Delta Pavonis against the Others.

Jacques's other clone; with Phineas he collects 20,000 Pav into stasis aboard refugee ships ahead of the Others.
A Bob who attends the moot after the defeat at Delta Pavonis.
A Bob named in passing in For We Are Many (chapter unknown).

bobs.about: One of two new clones Bill creates at Epsilon Eridani for a long-shot plan against the Others, built around his planet-moving SURGE technology. Nicknamed Ick.
sources: dennisetaylor.org/2017/04/07/genealogy-of-the-bobs/ (author comments) ('Daedalus and Icarus... Bill's clones. They're in book 3')

bobs.about: Icarus's partner clone, created by Bill at Epsilon Eridani for the same long-shot plan against the Others. Nicknamed Dae.
Bob who escorts the first three colony ships (refugees from the Vancouver Island and Japan enclaves) into 82 Eridani in Oct 2220 and stays as the system's resident Bob.
One of Bart's early clones (serial HIC-71683-8); pilots one of the first three colony ships to 82 Eridani. Wears T-shirt and jeans in VR.
One of Bart's early clones; pilots one of the first three colony ships to 82 Eridani.
One of Bart's early clones; pilots one of the first three colony ships to 82 Eridani and first names the inner planet Jotunheim (renamed Takamagahara).
Eighth-generation Bob who, with Neil, investigates two Others cargo ships disabled in the Battle of Delta Pavonis, drifting in that system's Kuiper belt (Mar 2227).

bobs.about: Eighth-generation Bob, Herschel's partner, investigating the derelict Others cargo ships at Delta Pavonis (Mar 2227); the two call themselves 'pond scum'.

bobs.about: A much later-generation Bob who rudely challenges Bob at a moot over interfering with possible native civilizations; also goes by 'Morlock'.

bobs.about: A faction of late-generation Bobs who dress in Star Trek TNG uniforms and insist on a Prime-Directive style of non-interference with biologicals.

bobs.about: Bob in Residence at Omicron² Eridani; lives in a Vulcan-jungle treehouse VR, drinks Coke; agrees to help Will set up an emigration society (Ever Onward).

bobs.about: Representative of the Gamers faction; LOTR-wizard avatar, Orthanc VR; plans the drone infiltration of the megastructure.
Spokesman of the Skippies (an AI-focused faction); an earlier-generation Bob than other Skippies; handles language/communications for the Bender search.

bobs.about: Representative of the Borg faction, which builds the android (manny) bodies for the Heaven's River expedition; would have preferred the name Hugh.
A Gamer (estimated ~24th generation) playing in the Gamers' live D&D campaign with Bill; considered unfriendly by older Bobs.

Leader of the Skippies; gives a speech before JOVAH v2 (Thoth) is activated. Skippies use IP-like designations rather than names.

A long-out-of-contact early Bob heading to galactic north, reporting by radio; Ferb intercepts his messages.
An 18th-generation Bob exploring near the Perseus Transit who is threatened by Starfleet and reports it to Bill.

others.about: Dr. Landers mentions him as a successful replicant who runs most of FAITH's mining equipment (Book 1 p. 22). The chapter is estimated.

others.kind: Brazilian Empire replicant probe (Major Ernesto Medeiros)
others.about: A Brazilian probe follows Bob from Earth to Epsilon Eridani (ch 12-13). Its replicant is Major Ernesto Medeiros, and Bob destroys it in Sept 2144.
Four Brazilian probes, clones of Capt. Matias Araujo, are steering asteroids at Earth when Riker and Homer arrive. The two Bobs destroy them by Apr 2157.
Calvin and Goku find a Medeiros autofactory at Alpha Centauri A and destroy it in Nov 2163. One Medeiros probe escapes.

others.kind: Destroyed United States of Eurasia von Neumann probe
others.about: Calvin finds the remains of a USE probe at Alpha Centauri B.

The Australian probe's replicant, a former sailor. Decades of isolation have left him half mad (he calls himself Emperor Mung) at Epsilon Indi. Linus shuts him down, gives him a sailing VR and nurses him back to health.
A Medeiros probe is already at 82 Eridani and ambushes Milo in Aug 2165. In Apr 2185 Khan's squadron fights several Medeiros clones there, using cloaked SURGE-drive missiles.
Two Medeiros copies holding 82 Eridani are destroyed by Loki's strike force in Nov 2195.
After her death on Vulcan, Bill secretly replicates Bridget; she is brought online at HIP 14101 in Oct 2220.
Professor of megastructures, replicated after death on Vulcan; consulted by Will.
Retired Quinlan professor Bob meets while working as a deckhand.
The true AI that administers Heaven's River (the 'Administrator').
An alien AI brought online in Skippyland in Feb 2336.
Theresa is scanned at death and becomes the first resident of the Quiniverse.
Newholme physicist replicant who advises Bill on FTL/wormholes.
Derelict alien replicant revived by Icarus and Daedalus.
Explains the PGF exodus and the Nemesis threat.

Claims to have created the original wormhole network; downloads all human history from Ick and Dae.
